posts.cooked:
Firstly, if we're not supposed to post stuff like this here, go ahead and delete this. I just thought I'd put out the word to as many of my forums as I can :). I would also normally write every post I make from scratch but this one is basically copy-pasted from the other forum I just posted it in, because I don't have time to write out a new post as I have to go to work about two minutes ago.

Someone I know on another forum has been making his own game which is very similar to Dungeon Keeper but has a lot more resource-related stuff. He's started a campaign to raise funds for it on a site called IndieGoGo (much the same as Kickstarter) and you can check out the details at the following link if it strikes your fancy :).

www.indiegogo.com/projects/dungeon-dwellers
